ellie: Bringing up cerulean-16b int4 on prod canary. Observed QA F1 drop vs fp16 (~-2.7) and sporadic OOMs after sustained traffic (~>120k tokens). Anyone seen int4 sample-level drift + mem frag together? :thinking:

sam: what's the quant recipe + batch settings? paste the serve config.
ellie: here's the model config we pushed to canary:
```
model: cerulean-16b
precision: int4
quant: per-channel asymmetric
bits: 4
recipe: l4x_custom_v2
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_size: 8
  max_concurrent_batches: 2
max_new_tokens_default: 512
kv_cache: enabled
kv_eviction_threshold: 0.9
```

rajesh: interesting — the max_new_tokens default 512 + batch_size 8 will tend to keep long-lived KV allocations. On int4 the allocator fragmentation shows up earlier. Can you share OOM trace?
ellie: log snippet from the driver:
```
[2026-02-18T13:12:05Z] OOM: cudaMalloc failed (out of memory) at alloc_kv_cache (size=1.2GB)
[2026-02-18T13:12:05Z] GPU mem free: 300MB, total cached: 12GB, fragments: 37
[2026-02-18T13:12:06Z] Eviction skipped: below threshold 0.9
```

nina: hunch: quant works but quality drop could be from symmetric quant noise + long context batching changing attention numerical ordering. Suggest two-prong: 1) reduce default max_new_tokens to 256, 2) reduce max_batch_size to 4 and increase max_concurrent_batches to 4 to keep latency but smaller per-batch mem spikes.

sam: Also set kv_eviction_threshold to 0.85 and enable kv_trim on idle sessions (session_cache_limit=1000 -> 100). Add warmup with small seqs to stabilize allocator: `--warmup-seqs 8`.

deploy-bot: deploy started for cerulean-16b int4 canary (build 20260218.3)

ellie: ran canary with those changes for 12 hours. No OOMs at ~520k tokens served. QA F1 delta improved from -2.7 -> -0.3 (sampled). P95 latency up ~3ms but within SLO. :rocket:

rajesh: can you file a regression eval to run 10k QA pairs vs fp16 and attach results? We'll decide if recipe needs tweaking for onboard.
ellie: filed eval -> https://redwood/internal/evals/cerulean16b-int4-20260218

nina: next steps: add int4-specific default profile that sets: max_new_tokens=256, max_batch_size=4, kv_eviction_threshold=0.85, warmup_seqs=8. Also run quantization ablation (symmetric vs asymmetric) on 1k QA samples.

sam: agree. low-risk rollout after 48h canary. Thanks all :thumbsup:
